card.name: Bondar
card.tagline: Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance)
card.profile: Bondar (literally "cooper") is a Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance). Its pattern is based on imitation of the professional movements of the cooper.
card.insight: Bondar (literally "cooper") is a Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance).

parts.note: Warm up exercises starting with feet and ankle movement.

steps.name: demi plie
steps.description: Half bend of the knees keeping heels on the floor.

steps.name: grand plie
steps.description: Full bend of the knees allowing heels to rise in certain positions.

steps.name: releve
steps.description: Rising onto the balls of the feet.

lessons.teacher_style: The instructor guides students through each movement with precise verbal terminology and hand demonstrations. She combines professional dance experience with clear instruction focusing on classical ballet technique.
lessons.distinctive_method: Explaining and demonstrating every exercise with hands first before performing it to music.
what_works: Clear verbal explanation combined with hand demonstration before execution.
what_hinders: Limited multi-angle demonstrations for foot placement.

evidence.observation: Instructor introduces herself while sitting in front of the ballet barre.
Instructor demonstrates foot articulation and demi pointes at the barre.
Instructor demonstrates arm positions and plie variations facing the camera without the barre.
